question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No.4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Learn** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words. 
 
 
• **Learn**: Gain or acquire knowledge of or skill in something by study, experience, or being taught. (सीखना)
 
• Plan: A method for doing or achieving something, usually involving a series of actions or stages. (परियोजना)
 
• Educate: To train or develop the knowledge, skill, mind, or character by formal schooling or study. (शिक्षित करना)
 
• Teach: Impart knowledge to or instruct someone as to how to do something. (शिक्षा देना)
 
 
 
• So, as per the meaning of the given words "Learn" is the most appropriate option.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.
